items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Coleman Hawkins was always the leader on that one. He'd come in around about an hour late and then follow the leader, and we got used to it.

ctx.x: Did that have an effect on the band working?

If Fletcher wanted you to start playing at 9 o'clock, he'll tell you about 7:30 or 8. Coleman Hawkins was always the leader on that one. He'd come in around about an hour late and then follow the leader, and we got used to it. If you didn't drink you weren't a member of the band.
You weren't a member of the band if you didn't drink?
